description: Defines the class interface for TextureGL, including structures for format and workaround info, and class methods for managing OpenGL textures within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: TextureGL
classes.description: OpenGL texture implementation class managing texture data, state, and operations.

methods.name: setImage
methods.description: Sets image data for the texture at a specific mip level and image index.

methods.name: setSubImage
methods.description: Updates a sub-region of the texture image.

methods.name: setCompressedImage
methods.description: Sets compressed image data for the texture.

methods.name: setCompressedSubImage
methods.description: Updates a sub-region of compressed texture data.

methods.name: copyImage
methods.description: Copies image data from a framebuffer to the texture.

methods.name: copySubImage
methods.description: Copies a sub-region from a framebuffer to the texture.

methods.name: copyTexture
methods.description: Copies data from another texture.

methods.name: copySubTexture
methods.description: Copies a sub-region from another texture.

methods.name: generateMipmap
methods.description: Generates mipmaps for the texture.

methods.name: bindTexImage
methods.description: Binds a surface as a texture image.

methods.name: releaseTexImage
methods.description: Releases the bound surface from the texture.

methods.name: setEGLImageTarget
methods.description: Associates an EGL image with the texture.

methods.name: getNativeID
methods.description: Returns the native OpenGL texture ID.

methods.name: setStorage
methods.description: Allocates immutable storage for the texture.

methods.name: setStorageMultisample
methods.description: Allocates multisample storage for the texture.

methods.name: setStorageExternalMemory
methods.description: Allocates external memory storage for the texture.

methods.name: setImageExternal
methods.description: Sets external image as texture data.

methods.name: setImageExternal (Stream version)
methods.description: Sets a stream as external image texture.

methods.name: setMinFilter
methods.description: Sets the minification filter.

methods.name: setMagFilter
methods.description: Sets the magnification filter.

methods.name: setSwizzle
methods.description: Sets the texture swizzle parameters.

methods.name: getNativeInternalFormat
methods.description: Returns the internal format of the texture.

methods.name: hasEmulatedAlphaChannel
methods.description: Checks if the texture level has an emulated alpha channel.
